tools.name: parse_efatura
tools.description: Reads one Turkish e-invoice (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv, UBL-TR 1.2 XML) and returns invoice number, ETTN, dates, supplier/customer (name, VKN/TCKN, tax office), lines, taxes (KDV, ÖTV), withholdings (tevkifat), totals, and a list of consistency checks. Costs $0.01 per successfully parsed invoice; failed pars

tools.name: efatura_demo
tools.description: Free. Returns parse_efatura output for a fictional sample invoice so you can see the JSON format.
